chunks.title: Brandon Foster Professional Overview & Domains
chunks.content:
Brandon Foster (brandocomando) is a Senior Platform & MLOps Engineer based in United States.
Headline: Building high-throughput distributed systems, sovereign AI infrastructure, and autonomous agent workflows.
Overview: Senior Platform, Distributed Systems, and MLOps Engineer with deep expertise in architecting cloud-native infrastructure, high-concurrency microservices, and AI-powered systems. Specialized in Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), GitOps (ArgoCD), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), enterprise streaming platforms (Kafka/Confluent), zero-trust security (mTLS, App Mesh), and local/production AI agent architectures. Proven track record leading multi-account cloud consolidations, large-scale Bitbucket-to-GitHub migrations, and saving over $10K/month in cloud FinOps optimizations.

Core Technical Domains: Platform Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Distributed Systems & Service Mesh (Kubernetes, AWS App Mesh, mTLS), AI Infrastructure & MLOps (Local LLMs, Agentic Teams, RAG Pipelines), Data Platforms & Streaming (Kafka, Confluent Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks), Observability & SRE (Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), FinOps & Cloud Cost Optimization.
Contact: Connect via Portfolio Contact Page | GitHub: https://github.com/brandocomando | LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/brandon-foster

chunks.title: Project: My Agentic Team
chunks.content:
[TECHNICAL PROJECT] My Agentic Team
Repository: https://github.com/brandocomando/my_agentic_team (GitHub Stars: 0)
Tagline: A production-minded, local-first compilation of autonomous AI agents automating real-world daily workflows.
Overview: A sophisticated multi-agent system featuring specialized agents running locally with Ollama and browser automation. Includes a Campsite Finder Agent (automated availability scanner across ReserveCalifornia and Recreation.gov using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), batch grid endpoints, and AI scoring), a Gmail Inbox Triage Agent (sub-50ms priority labeling, noise archiving, daily executive summaries), a Personal Finance Agent (CSV ingestion, deterministic transaction categorization), and a Survey Copilot Chrome extension. Currently integrating Laya for System-1 fast inference decisions.
Key Architectural Highlights:
  • Local-first LLM inference using Ollama, eliminating external API latency and privacy risks
  • CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) headless browser orchestration for complex web workflows
  • Modular agent communication protocol with structured JSON tool invocation
Tech Stack: Python, Ollama, Local LLMs, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Docker, OAuth2, Laya

chunks.title: Project: Prometheus Ingress Status Exporter
chunks.content:
[TECHNICAL PROJECT] Prometheus Ingress Status Exporter
Repository: https://github.com/brandocomando/prometheus-ingress-status-exporter (GitHub Stars: 2)
Tagline: Kubernetes controller & exporter that discovers Ingress endpoints dynamically and exports response metrics to Prometheus.
Overview: A high-performance Go daemon that connects to the Kubernetes API, watches Ingress resources dynamically across namespaces, executes synthetic HTTP/HTTPS health checks against host rules and TLS configurations, and exports Prometheus-compatible response codes, latency percentiles, and availability metrics.
Key Architectural Highlights:
  • Written in pure Go using official Kubernetes client-go and Prometheus client libraries
  • Asynchronous goroutine worker pools with rate-limiting to prevent probing denial-of-service
  • Provides instant cluster-wide edge health observability for SRE and platform teams
Tech Stack: Go (Golang), Kubernetes (client-go), Prometheus, Docker, SRE / Observability

chunks.title: Project: WezTerm Agent Deck
chunks.content:
[TECHNICAL PROJECT] WezTerm Agent Deck
Repository: https://github.com/brandocomando/wezterm-agent-deck (GitHub Stars: 0)
Tagline: Real-time status monitoring and tab indicators for AI coding agents inside WezTerm.
Overview: A Lua plugin for the WezTerm terminal emulator that monitors active AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Aider). Displays native tab indicators for agent states (working, waiting for input, idle, inactive) and triggers desktop notifications when an agent finishes or requires attention.
Key Architectural Highlights:
  • Lightweight event hooks in Lua with zero CPU polling overhead
  • Desktop notifications and audio cues via terminal-notifier
  • Streamlines human-in-the-loop developer interaction with multiple parallel autonomous coding agents
Tech Stack: Lua, WezTerm, AI Agent Tooling, Shell

chunks.title: Project: FinOps-Optimized Cloud Portfolio & AI MLOps Platform
chunks.content:
[TECHNICAL PROJECT] FinOps-Optimized Cloud Portfolio & AI MLOps Platform
Repository: https://github.com/brandocomando/portfolio (GitHub Stars: 0)
Tagline: Production-grade, scale-to-zero GCP portfolio featuring hybrid RAG, Medallion data pipeline, CI/CD, and Terraform.
Overview: An end-to-end cloud platform hosting a modern React SPA on Firebase Hosting (CDN), a FastAPI backend on Cloud Run scaling to zero ($0 idle cost), and an in-memory Hybrid RAG engine (Dense + BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion) answering queries via Gemini Flash. Features multi-tier token bucket rate limiting, Firebase Auth recruiter lead capture, a Medallion Data Lakehouse, and an offline LLM-as-a-judge evaluation suite running as a quality gate in GitHub Actions. 100% Terraform IaC with Workload Identity Federation (zero static keys).
Key Architectural Highlights:
  • Strict FinOps compliance: $0/month idle cost via Cloud Run and Firebase Hosting
  • Workload Identity Federation (OIDC) eliminating static GCP credentials in CI/CD
  • Continuous evaluation CI gate testing context recall and answer faithfulness
Tech Stack: Terraform, Google Cloud Run, Firebase Hosting, FastAPI, Python, React / Vite / TypeScript, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Hybrid Search (BM25 + Dense RRF), GitHub Actions (OIDC/WIF)
